3169544f-4b87-4a14-917b-f73600941f55.altTitle: Noa is My Senior, and My Friend.
3169544f-4b87-4a14-917b-f73600941f55.description:
A bitter and painful adult's life needs "friends".  Set in a game company, Rihito Otsuka (23), who is your everyday salaryman, and Noa Saotome (27), the ultimate career woman. Two characters whose lives aren't supposed to intersect become "friends" by chance.

Noa-Senpai's Last Workday of The Year
Noa-Senpai and A Bittersweet Christmas Party

5c3e27c4-2ff1-4b66-968e-8b813653192e.title: Isekai Ryouridou
5c3e27c4-2ff1-4b66-968e-8b813653192e.description: Main protagonist is Tsurumi Asuta. 17 yrs old, 2nd year high schooler. He was working as an apprentice cook at Tsurumi-ya, managed by his father. One day a fire broke out in Tsurumi-ya, for the sake of his father's cherished knife 'Santoku Houchou' he ran back inside to retrieve it and thus met his end. Before he knew it he awoke to an unknown environment. He was then attacked by a beast resembling a boar but a girl named Aifa, from the People of Morihen, saved him. It was then that he realized he was really in different world.

chapters.title: What's the Secret of the Sweetness?!
A Hot and Red Chitto Pot

2140fb9a-122f-44c3-987c-38c384eea2c0.title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai Side Stories
2140fb9a-122f-44c3-987c-38c384eea2c0.description: A collection of side stories of [Kimi ga Shinu Made Koi wo Shitai](https://mangadex.org/title/0c44cf39-3d6c-4472-815b-9e163613cfe9/kimi-ga-shinu-made-koi-wo-shitai).

f8a557fe-2d23-49da-88b0-fb50cefa5f94.title: 5-kaime no Jinsei, Tensei Shitara Shinisou na Koji deshita
f8a557fe-2d23-49da-88b0-fb50cefa5f94.altTitle: On My Fifth Life, I Was Reincarnated as an Orphan on the Verge of Death
f8a557fe-2d23-49da-88b0-fb50cefa5f94.description:
After being reincarnated time and time again, Nadi, a girl who has lived through four previous lives, is given an extremely hard-mode existence as an orphan in a slum in her fifth life.

In one life, she was a highly skilled apothecary. In another, she was the strongest adventurer, powerful enough to defeat even the Demon King. Now that Nadi has regained the memories of her past lives, she decides to use all the skills and knowledge she has accumulated to pursue a comfortable life!

Even when her daily life is filled with one problem after another, her knowledge from her past lives and mastery of magic allow her to solve everything with ease!

A long-awaited manga adaptation of a fantasy adventure about an extraordinary, unbelievably powerful young girl!

c4b1cb49-46e9-405d-8b48-8104de22e659.title: COSMOS
c4b1cb49-46e9-405d-8b48-8104de22e659.description: Kaede's search for a missing classmate leads to the shocking discovery that his friend is actually an alien in a human flesh suit. Grateful for Kaede's help with her case, cute and ruthless insurance investigator Rin headhunts him. Kaede's job interview leads to an epic battle on a commuter train, alien treachery, and a hidden spaceship. But before he can decide whether to accept the position or not, Kaede discovers another alien hidden in plain sight—one with a tragic story to share.

0d469356-5a87-41d0-8e42-bc6e155bb665.title: Meoto de Safari
0d469356-5a87-41d0-8e42-bc6e155bb665.description:
A romantic adventure in another world where a newlywed couple with a significant age difference forges their bond!


"How many children do you want?" "? Oh... well, you can have as many as you like."
She was filled with anxiety about marrying someone she didn't know, but... Her fiancé was a younger, handsome, "cute" guy!!
And strong too!! The bride fell in love at first sight with her groom, who easily defeated monsters. They immediately try to make it to their wedding night,
but...? A newlywed couple with a significant age difference, experiencing everything for the first time, hunt beasts and nurture their love!?

aa828b9c-1ba6-45f5-86dd-67e3cad357f4.title: Gakumon! School of Monsters
aa828b9c-1ba6-45f5-86dd-67e3cad357f4.altTitle: Gakumon! The Werewolf Girl Won't Lose Heart
aa828b9c-1ba6-45f5-86dd-67e3cad357f4.description: Shushu is enrolling in the prestigious Monster Academy in order to become a wolfman like her father. There's just one problem: Shushu isn't a man!

chapters.title: Juz, Son of the Monster King

85a99758-de39-471e-9f6d-800547f53d0a.title: Tougen Anki
85a99758-de39-471e-9f6d-800547f53d0a.altTitle: Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood
85a99758-de39-471e-9f6d-800547f53d0a.description: Ichinose Shiki, an inheritor of the blood of Oni had lived out his entire childhood oblivious to this fact. However, when an unknown man comes rushing into his home in attempts to assassinate him, his foster father finally reveals the truth. In a world where Oni and Momotarou have never been able to coexist, join Ichinose in his struggle for power and unifying the two races!

chapters.title: I Believed You'd Come For Me

59d95bf5-d871-4b04-8e65-501a53140b6e.title: Shinimodori no Akuyaku Reijou wa, Nidome no Jinsei de Subete o Shiawase ni Shitemiseru
59d95bf5-d871-4b04-8e65-501a53140b6e.altTitle: The Rewound Villainess Will Make Everyone Happy
59d95bf5-d871-4b04-8e65-501a53140b6e.description:
In a world where only nobles possess magic, Eltriede, the daughter of a duke, was born without any magical power. Branded "magicless", she endured a life of ridicule and scorn from those around her.

Determined to prove everyone wrong, she set her sights on becoming the crown prince’s consort. But her ruthless schemes and unscrupulous methods were eventually exposed, and her life ended at the executioner’s block.

Yet when she opened her eyes, she found herself returned to the body of her eight years old self.

Haunted by the mistakes of her previous life, Eltriede resolves to walk an entirely different path this time. But for some reason, the very crown prince who once sentenced her to death, Kistohart, has begun taking an unusual interest in her…?!

chapters.title: Villainess Muda yang Kembali dari Kematian
The Villainess Who Returns to Death

ef97c4a5-035e-4726-8ddc-cbec21f991a7.title: Gyaru to Otaku wa Wakari Aenai.
ef97c4a5-035e-4726-8ddc-cbec21f991a7.altTitle: Gal and Otaku Can't Understand Each Other
ef97c4a5-035e-4726-8ddc-cbec21f991a7.description:
Saotome is the top Gyaru in class - she's loud, known by everyone, and stylish. Otonashi, on the other hand, is the complete opposite. These two carry their own baggage that would ruin their built up identities… but what happens if they were to discover each other's secret?  
  
Read now to see the humorous life of how they do their best to avoid spilling the other's secret!

72d8aa14-7d96-4782-9a90-f12a8edcaf78.title: Turning Point
72d8aa14-7d96-4782-9a90-f12a8edcaf78.description:
Baek Sarang, who was comfortable eating alone, meditating alone, and drinking alone.
Yu Pyeonghwa wants to get along with others even at a loss.
Love and peace, who have lived conflicting lives, meet each other and learn a new way of life.
A realistic romance that is more adult than you think and more childish than you think

9d877635-9e48-4780-b77d-398a43357641.title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - An Invitation From Afar (Doujinshi)
9d877635-9e48-4780-b77d-398a43357641.description:
Maya, who is currently a member of the New National Troupe in Japan, has received an invitation from Claudine - her former acting partner - to go watch her new play that will be showing at the Theatre Du Flamme in France. Maya is excited to evaluate Claudine's progress since they last met, but feels internally conflicted when she sees Claudine acting alongside her new co-star.

[ Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi ]

Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

Pairing: Tendou Maya and Saijou Claudine

6df1a6d3-2b1f-4254-87b4-b620a86d6ebf.title: Raising the Princess After Her Death
6df1a6d3-2b1f-4254-87b4-b620a86d6ebf.altTitle: Raising the Princess to Overcome Death
6df1a6d3-2b1f-4254-87b4-b620a86d6ebf.description:
Long-term public service exam candidate Minseo finds himself trapped in the game, "Raising Lena", as he tries to escape his grim reality. 

In the game, Minseo becomes a character named Leo, and he must navigate through a world with three different scenarios to accomplish his mission of turning the game's protagonist, Lena, into a princess. However, "Raising Lena" boasts an overwhelming level of difficulty due to enemies who are set to thwart Minseo with their immense power and influence.

Will Minseo be able to complete the game by making Lena a princess and return to reality?

4aecf422-7afe-405f-b2d4-e5b80a1872ac.title: Megane, Tokidoki, Yankee-kun
4aecf422-7afe-405f-b2d4-e5b80a1872ac.altTitle: Glasses with a Chance of Delinquent
4aecf422-7afe-405f-b2d4-e5b80a1872ac.description:
Momose, a clumsy girl who has always been slaved around to run errands by delinquents in her middle school, will now be attending a non-yankee high school. At her new school, she thinks of joining a club so as to not bother anyone and one day meets a classmate, a serious boy with glasses, Ichikura-kun. In reality though, that Ichikura has been an undefeated yankee in his middle school which he hid from everyone when he enrolled into this high school!

Momose is the only one who knows Ichikura-kun's secret yankee past?!

The youthful former yankee X a girl who was bullied by yankees are now having a LOVE SURVIVAL ♡

Note: Initially ended in 2 volumes. But due to its high popularity, the serialization will continue in Betsufure issue 7/2022 out June 13, 2022.
